clue.text: Dawn follows Alan back after ordering quite alcoholic drink

indicators.note: after means the reversed name comes after the rearranged letters
follows means the dawn word comes at the end
ordering means putting into a new order, so the letters of quite are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: back means the short name is read in reverse

parts.note: Al is the short form of Alan
dawn is sunrise

explanation.surface: Dawn trails after Alan, who has just ordered quite a strong drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Quite rearranged gives TEQUI; AL backwards gives LA; then SUNRISE. Dawn and Alan look like two people, but both are wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A tequila sunrise is a cocktail of tequila, orange juice and grenadine, so it is a mixed alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Abstaining from key activity of a lumberjack

parts.note: Esc is the escape key on a computer keyboard

explanation.walkthrough: Key suggests a main point, but it is a keyboard key.
explanation.definitionFit: To eschew is to deliberately avoid something, so eschewing means keeping off or refraining from it.

clue.text: Radical mid-section of hull on craft drawn up

explanation.walkthrough: Craft looks like a vessel to match hull, but it means skill.
explanation.definitionFit: Ultra as an adjective or noun describes someone extreme in their views, the same idea as radical.

clue.text: Bridge playing opens with relative losing unspecified amount

explanation.walkthrough: Was in bed reads as one phrase; the definition is only Was in, the cricket sense, and bed is wordplay.

clue.text: Where one might see jumpers and headwear
